description: This file defines an interface for diagnostics related to log consistency in Orleans grains, along with a class for collecting related statistics.

classes.name: LogConsistencyStatistics
classes.description: A collection of statistics for grains using log-consistency, including event counters and stabilization latencies.

methods.name: EnableStatsCollection
methods.description: Turns on the statistics collection for this log-consistent grain.

methods.name: DisableStatsCollection
methods.description: Turns off the statistics collection for this log-consistent grain.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves the collected statistics for this log-consistent grain.
